rows.headline: Target Lifts Full-Year Outlook as Recovery Efforts Gain Ground
rows.prelim_note: Target raises FY net-sales growth guide to ~5% (from ~4%) and ex-tariff-refund EPS to $8.25-$9.25 (from $7.50-$8.50) after Q2 comp sales +3.8% vs 2.4% consensus - shifts analyst estimates (estimate_impact / guidance_change).

rows.headline: Madison Air to Acquire ebm-papst, Expanding Return on Air Capabilities and Accelerating Durable Growth in Air Quality Solutions
rows.prelim_note: Definitive agreement to acquire ebm-papst for $5.4bn enterprise value (14.6x 2026 EBITDA, 10x incl. run-rate synergies), funded via cash/debt/equity - alters capital structure and nearly doubles addressable market (mna / capital_actions).

rows.headline: SK Hynix Announces $28.6 Billion Share Buyback on AI Boom
rows.prelim_note: Regulatory filing to buy back and cancel ~24m shares (40tn won, ~$29bn) between Aug 20-Nov 19, pledges over 50% of 2025-27 free cash flow to shareholder returns, after shares fell 9.8% in regular trading - capital_actions.

rows.headline: Lowe's Reports Second Quarter 2026 Sales and Earnings Results
rows.prelim_note: Q2 comp sales +0.2% on continued home-improvement spending pressure; cuts FY guide to $92bn sales (flat comps, was flat-to-+2%) and adjusted EPS to $12.25 (was $12.25-$12.75) - guidance_change, shares -2% premarket.

rows.headline: The Estee Lauder Companies Reports Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter and Full-Year Results
rows.prelim_note: Q4 revenue $3.63bn beat $3.55bn consensus, adjusted EPS $0.39 beat $0.32 consensus; raised FY27 adjusted operating margin outlook to 12.7%-13.5% - estimate_impact / guidance_change.

rows.headline: The TJX Companies Reports Q2 FY27 Results Above Plan, Comp Sales Growth of 4%
rows.prelim_note: Q2 FY27 diluted EPS $1.36 and net sales +5% both above plan, comp sales +4%; returned $1.3bn to shareholders (5.1m shares repurchased) - raises FY27 guidance (estimate_impact).

rows.headline: Fabrinet Announces Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
rows.prelim_note: Record Q4 revenue $1.316bn (+45% YoY) beat guide, but non-GAAP gross margin fell to 12.2% (from 12.5%) and free cash flow swung to -$36.9m (from +$70.4m) as capex absorbed cash - shares fell double digits despite the beat (earnings_revenue_margin).

rows.headline: Bond Slump Sends Long-Term Debt Costs to Highest in Decades
rows.prelim_note: 30-year US Treasury yield hits highest since 2007; French, German, UK and Japanese long-dated yields also at multi-year/decade highs; 10-year US yield ~4.75%, highest in 19 months - raises financing costs for duration-sensitive and highly-levered names (macro_sector).

rows.headline: Oil Climbs as Fading US-Iran Peace Hopes Raise Supply Risks
rows.prelim_note: WTI crude climbed from ~$82 to above $85/bbl over three sessions after Trump said he was not interested in extending the interim Iran peace deal - supply/demand dynamics for oil-linked sectors (macro_sector).
